hadith:
Supporting the Family - Narrated Abu Huraira:

The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "The one who looks after a widow or a poor person is like a Mujahid (warrior) who fights for Allah's Cause, or like him who performs prayers all the night and fasts all the day."
message: Reflect on the profound meaning behind the name Al Hameed, recognizing that all goodness stems from Allah and deserves our utmost praise and gratitude. Just as supporting those in need can elevate us spiritually, let us strive to embody compassion and kindness towards others, especially widows and the less fortunate. May we find solace and strength in remembering that Allah knows all things and guides us towards righteousness.
name:
Al Hameed - الْحَمِيدُ - The Praised

The name Al Hameed emphasizes the significance of Allah's nature as deserving of all praise and commendation. It recognizes that all good qualities and actions originate from Him, and humanity is encouraged to acknowledge and express gratitude for His blessings. The term comes from the Arabic root 'ḥ-m-d,' which relates to praise and commendation.
verse:
Al-Jumu'ah - The Congregation, Friday - 62:6-7

Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O Jews! If you claim to be Allah’s chosen ˹people˺ out of all humanity, then wish for death, if what you say is true.”

But they will never wish for that because of what their hands have done. And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of the wrongdoers.
